name: The Path of the Sanctuaries
summary:
The Path of the Sanctuaries is a VR experience that lets you enjoy an immersive 360º documentary where past and present come together along one of Asturias’ most iconic cultural routes.

The experience begins inside a medieval cabin, where a map laid out on the central table serves as the main interaction point. Throughout the documentary, you’ll witness the passage of time from the Middle Ages to the present through landscapes and the hidden stories that have shaped this historic path.
